name: Splendor
description: Players act as wealthy Renaissance merchants acquiring mines, transportation methods, and artisans to covertly garner the most prestige points.

name: Avalon
description: A social deduction game of hidden loyalties where loyal servants of Arthur battle against the minions of Mordred.

name: Dixit
description: A lightweight game of storytelling, guesswork, and imagination using beautifully illustrated surreal cards.

name: Piles
description: A fast-moving card game focused on stacking and organizing assets efficiently under pressure.

name: 7 Wonders
description: A fast-paced card drafting game where players develop one of the ancient world's great city-states across three ages.

name: Saboteur
description: A semi-cooperative tunneling card game where gold-seeking dwarves try to sniff out paths while secret saboteurs attempt to derail them.

name: 1 Night Ultimate Werewolf
description: A fast-paced deduction game for up to ten players where someone is a werewolf, but roles shift throughout a single thrilling night.

name: Monopoly Deal
description: A fast-playing, portable card game version of Monopoly where players race to collect three complete property sets.

name: Uno No Mercy
description: A much harsher version of classic UNO packed with brutal stackable penalties, hand-limit limits, and elimination rules.

name: Love Letter
description: A micro-game of risk, deduction, and luck where players try to deliver their romantic letter to the Princess.

name: Shallow Regrets
description: An unsettling, compact eldritch fishing card game where players reel in bizarre deep-sea horrors for a quick payout.

name: Catan
description: The classic strategy board game where settlers trade, build, and develop holdings across a modular hexagonal island.
